Acura Urban Spec Trim Is a Fresh Limited Edition for 2027 Integra, ADX, and MDX Focused on Style
7 photos
Photo: Acura
The premium Japanese brand of American Honda has created the curated Acura Urban Spec grade for the 2027 model year of the Integra compact liftback, ADX subcompact luxury crossover SUV, and the popular MDX mid-size CUV.
American Honda recently pledged no less than $3 billion in investments in the United States focused on hybrids via multiple facilities, including a new auto plant in Central Ohio, as it said that it wants to “meet growing customer demand for hybrid vehicles in North America.” Both the namesake Honda brand and the premium Acura division will benefit from the additional investments as the company seeks to increase local production to about 1.3 million units annually and no less than 1.9 million in total across North America.
Well, Acura needs all the help it can get because although American Honda announced the best October month across the US automotive market in six years, the 8% growth to 120k units was entirely supported by the namesake Honda brand (+9.1%) while Acura dropped by 2.5%. The year-to-date situation is a little better, as the premium brand has risen by 3.7% but only to a mere 114k units.
Anyway, it’s pretty clear that AHM wants to support Acura and make it more enticing for customers, with the premium brand now announcing “a new level of style, exclusivity and incredible value to its 2027 lineup,” all thanks to the introduction of the fresh but limited-edition Urban Spec trim for the Acura Integra, ADX, and MDX.
All versions mix the premium Urban Gray paint with exclusive gloss-black exterior details and larger wheels and tires for about $1,500 above the entry MSRP, “delivering standout design at an attractive price.” The new grade is reaching dealerships in December and will be presented to the public during the Los Angeles Auto Show (November 19-29), but official pricing details will arrive later, closer to the launch date.
"The new Acura Urban Spec trim is all about giving our customers standout design and added value across the Acura lineup," said Jessika Laudermilk, assistant vice president of Acura National Sales. "For Integra, ADX and MDX, we've brought together many of the design elements our customers love the most, creating limited-production Acura products that look special without a significant step up in price."
For the 2027 Acura Integra, the Urban Spec features include the Urban Gray paint, an Ebony interior, and Black 18-inch A-Spec wheels, wheel lugs, door handles, decklid spoiler, antenna, and badges. The 2027 ADX gets the Urban Gray paint, Ebony interior, optional AWD, and all the Black details except for the wheels, which grow to 19 inches.
Last but not least, the 2027 MDX packs the Urban Gray paint, Ebony interior, available SH-AWD, all the black details from the other two, plus the bumper and wheel well trim, along with even larger 20-inch A-Spec Advance wheels. So, what do you think?
